findings.message: a test plants a shell script as a fixture program: it cannot run on Windows and does not say what the real program prints
findings.fix: Install the testkit's stand-in instead: `paddock_testkit::StandIn::new(dir, "name").stdout(..).exit(..).records_args().install()?` (it runs on Windows and records its calls). A fixture that has to be a script carries `// conformance: stand-in — <why>`; an existing site is listed in conformance/c130-allow.json until it is converted.

findings.message: a stand-in waiver beyond the count of its allow entry
findings.fix: Waivers are counted, so none is free: list it in conformance/c130-allow.json (path, site `conformance: stand-in`, a reason and the file's count), which the user approves, or convert the fixture to `StandIn`.
